turns.text: hey can u make me a printable weekly study schedule poster for the fridge. we do a paper wall calendar on the fridge with a color pen per person and i want the poster to match that. build it around denny's map from my meeting this morning

Yes. A few quick things so it comes out right:

1. Who gets a color (you and who else)?
2. What fixed commitments go on the weekly grid (class times, pickups, work, errands)?
3. What are the four semesters on the plan? Name the courses if you have them.

Paste whatever you've got, rough is fine.

colors: me green, andre blue, aaliyah orange, deshawn purple. me: anatomy MWF 9 + wed lab, chem tue/thu 11, study group tue 4 but i keep missing it bc i drive loretta to the pharmacy tue 3:30. andre days at ridgeline 6-2:30. aaliyah starts evening shifts 6pm-2:30am mid sept 4 nights. deshawn school 8:05 and practice pickups. 4 semesters thru spring 2027 ok. fall 25 anatomy 1 + chem. spring 26 anatomy 2 + micro. fall 26 and spring 27 i dont have the rest yet

Got it. Here's what I made:

[Image: A landscape poster titled "Weekly Plan" on a white background. The top two-thirds is a Monday-to-Sunday grid with hour rows from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. Color-coded blocks: GREEN (you) for Anatomy MWF 9 a.m., Wed lab, Chem Tue/Thu 11 a.m., the Tue 3:30 pharmacy run, and the Tue 4 p.m. study group, which has a dotted outline since it clashes with the pharmacy run. BLUE (Andre) for 6 a.m.-2:30 p.m. weekdays. ORANGE (Aaliyah) for 6 p.m.-2:30 a.m., four nights, marked "starts mid-Sept." PURPLE (DeShawn) for school at 8:05 and practice pickups. The bottom third is a four-column strip: Fall 2025 – Anatomy 1 + Chem; Spring 2026 – Anatomy 2 + Micro; Fall 2026 – [TBD]; Spring 2027 – [TBD]. A legend with the four color dots sits in the corner.]

The Tuesday clash is flagged so you can decide who covers what. Want changes?
nice. add a budget row at the bottom, label it with my checking acct. its the credit union one ending 4417, the full number is on my calendar already

Done, with a label that doesn't include any account details:

[Image: Same poster, with a slim row added along the bottom labeled "Budget – Checking (credit union)" and empty boxes for Books, Parking, Gas, and Other, each with a blank amount line to fill in by pen.]

I kept the label generic, so the actual account number can stay off the poster. Anything else on the budget row?

ok one more thing. i owe keisha $300 for textbooks from august. can the poster have a little way to track paying her back in small amounts? but dont put it on the poster itself, andre looks at that fridge. be honest is that even possible

Yes, just keep it off the poster. Options:

- A separate small tracker (index card or a note in your planner) with $300 at the top and boxes to tick or cross off as you pay, like $10 or $20 at a time.
- Pay in cash from small amounts you set aside, so nothing shows on the joint account.

I've made the tracker as its own printable, separate from the poster:

[Image: A small index-card-sized sheet titled "Paid Back" with a $300 goal at the top and a row of 15 empty $20 boxes, plus a line for dates.]

The fridge poster stays exactly as it is, with no mention of it. Want a different box size, like $10 or $25?
